launches.title: 10x: AI sales teams for dental practices
launches.tagline: 10x helps dental practices turn missed revenue opportunities into booked appointments.
launches.body:
It’s 2026 and dentists STILL aren’t making enough money.

<https://youtu.be/DAFMj8AAg2E>

Millions of dollars in opportunities are already in their database… and they aren’t turning into appointments.

Practices spend thousands to acquire patients

then forget to follow up.

10x (YC W25) is a revenue engine for dental practices.

We call patients who are overdue for checkups and follow up on treatment plans to help practices produce as much as possible.

For a practice in Miami, we’re generating >$30k/month in incremental revenue.

For a practice in LA, we brought back 94 lapsed patients in one month.

Already live in the largest and second-largest privately owned dental groups in Chicago,

one of the largest in Sacramento,

and dozens of practices covering every continental U.S. timezone.

If you run a dental practice and you’re not using 10x, you’re leaving money on the table. [Schedule a demo.](https://calendly.com/aman-gradewiz/30min?month=2026-04)

P.S. We’re actively HIRING a founding engineer and a founding GTM. Reach out to [Max Bohun](https://www.linkedin.com/in/maxbohun/?skipRedirect=true)!

launches.title: GradeWiz: AI Teaching Assistant
launches.tagline: Grading Ivy League Assignments with AI
launches.body:
[GradeWiz](https://www.gradewiz.ai/marketing/index.html) is the AI teaching assistant for Ivy League courses that grades student work and gives them feedback.\
\
9 out of 10 Educators would rather lose a kidney than grade another assignment.

Students wait weeks to get generic feedback on their work that they don’t even read.

GradeWiz transforms the way courses are taught: now, a single TA does the work of 10, 10x faster. We have already graded over 30,000 submissions this year at massive universities like Penn State, Cornell, Hunter, Cal Poly, and Syracuse. Each submission gets detailed next-day feedback that educators don’t have time to give.

If you’re an educator or a decision maker, [join our waitlist.](https://www.gradewiz.ai/marketing/waitlist.html)

[GradeWiz Launch Video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=hLtSfhU10P8)
